pixel_observations.description: Colour-Doppler ultrasound clip on a black background with the same blank dark blue banner at the top. Printed device text at the upper left reads AP 96.6% MI 1.3 TIS 1.4 with a red heart symbol, and at the upper right the logo Mindray, M9T and a settings list (B, F PH3.4, D 15.0, G 67, FR 15, DR 115, iClear 4, Echo Boost, C, F 2.5, G 48, WF 353, PRF 3.5k) beside a colour bar printed 52.2 at the top and -52.2 at the bottom. A white outlined colour box covers the chambers. At 0 s a broad orange-yellow mosaic stream with red above and blue below fills the middle of the box; at 1 s a broad blue stream lies in the upper left chamber beside an orange-yellow mosaic; at 2 s an orange-yellow stream with red above it fills the middle. No arrow, patient name, clock or date is visible.
